title: Prepare a tutoring context, deck, session, and Notes
persona: A tutor keeping durable context and a compact post-session record around a reusable outline.
purpose: Walk the dedicated collection, creation, deck editor, session, and Notes routes without merging CRUD surfaces.
outcome: A tutor can create durable preparation context, save an outline version, start a session, and write the record.
prerequisites: The local demo account alice/demo is enabled.

chapters.title: Create a tutoring context
chapters.narration: We open the contexts collection. Context is durable preparation information, not the original school document. It has its own collection and its own creation route.

chapters.title: Create and version a deck
chapters.narration: From the context detail we create a separate deck. The deck editor owns the structured outline and its version history; it does not become a second collection inspector.

chapters.title: Write the record after the session
chapters.narration: A session exists because it was started, not booked. After the session, the dedicated record form holds compact outcomes and homework rather than a transcript.
